summary: Iteration 66 — validated 5 new backend endpoints and 5 UI touch-points (Admin CRM header cards, TC Reports 3rd table, TC Log Call attribution + want_to_order). 8/8 pytest passed, all UI testids present, cross-dashboard cleanup + mark-order-by-other-tc verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 10032 lines — well beyond the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting endpoints into routers (leads, orders, admin, tc) per resource. Not a blocker but ongoing tech-debt.

create_lead prior-order 409 uses a regex on customer_phone ({"$regex": phone_norm[-10:]}). Combined with an $or that also matches raw phone, this is fine but slower than a normalized field lookup. Recommend a customer_phone_norm field on orders for O(1) index lookups.
seed_data_creation: 3 TEST_iter66 leads inserted via direct mongo (to seed the cross-dashboard scenario the API's dupe-check normally prevents). All test data cleaned up post-run (delete_many on source=TEST_iter66 + name~=TEST_iter66 leads + TEST_iter66 orders).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_iter66_features.py uses direct mongo insert to seed shared-phone leads for TC1/TC2/TC3 because /api/leads dupe-check would otherwise refuse. Order response comes back as {order, message} wrapper; GET /api/leads/{id} returns {lead, orders} wrapper. Admin route is /dashboard (not /admin/crm-panel). AdminCRMPanel header uses uppercase CSS on labels, so text search must ignore case if checking programmatically.
